You asked: can I keep my doctor if I change Medicare plans? It depends on the plan type. Medicare Advantage plans usually use networks, and networks can change each year. Original Medicare, with or without a Medicare Supplement, works with any doctor who accepts Medicare. Before Dec 7, we check your doctors and hospital against each plan you are considering. Call (571) 354-0146.

We do not offer every plan available in your area. Any information we provide is limited to those plans we do offer in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
